- Overestimate prices in early forecast windows, especially after sharp spikes; reduce initial forecast values by 5–10%.
- Underestimate during prolonged downward trends; increase forecast by 5–10% to account for mean reversion.
- Overshoot after sudden price spikes; apply a 1–2 day lag correction to avoid overreacting to recent volatility.
- Model tends to underestimate true outcomes in the 10–15 day horizon; adjust forecast upward by 3–5% for this range.
- Avoid overfitting to recent history; if last 5–7 days show strong downward momentum, reduce forecast slope to prevent premature reversal.
